title: TBN world and DTED terrain

size.description: World dimensions in meters: a 1 km cube. World ground plane is X/Z, elevation is +Y; distinct from the actor body frame (+X forward, +Y left, +Z up). Sent from server to client on connection.

terrain.description: Configurable row-major DTED posts in world X/Z, with Y elevation. Index = row * columns + column; columns advance +X, rows advance +Z. Spacing is in meters; integer elevation samples are in 0.1 m units. Half-open sampling excludes the far world boundary: columns = ceil(width / spacing.x), rows = ceil(depth / spacing.z). Validate those relationships and depthMap.length = rows * columns separately from JSON Schema. Collision/render topology: each cell uses triangles (a,c,b), (b,c,d) with a=(col,row), b=(col+1,row), c=(col,row+1), d=(col+1,row+1). Duplicate last post heights to the far width/depth boundary; omit triangles touching noData posts. Terrain is fixed during gameplay; an explicit admin flatten or preset change replaces its frozen snapshot and republishes map_data. Clients must rebuild terrain on replacement map_data.

width.description: X extent in meters, matching world size.x for full-world terrain.

depth.description: Z extent in meters, matching world size.z for full-world terrain.

columns.description: ceil(width / spacing.x); 4000 for width 1000 m at 0.25 m spacing.

rows.description: ceil(depth / spacing.z); 4000 for depth 1000 m at 0.25 m spacing.

x.description: Configurable distance between adjacent columns, meters.

z.description: Configurable distance between adjacent rows, meters.

elevationScale.description: Meters per stored elevation unit. World Y = sample * elevationScale; 123 means 12.3 m.

noDataValue.description: Optional missing-data sentinel; detect before converting elevation or interpolating.

depthMap.description: Flat row-major integer elevation array in 0.1 m units. Exactly rows * columns entries. Post world coordinates: X = origin.x + column * spacing.x, Z = origin.z + row * spacing.z, Y = depthMap[row * columns + column] * elevationScale. A 4000 by 4000 grid contains 16000000 entries.

preset.description: Optional server preset identifier. Render depthMap as authoritative; never regenerate from this label.

oneOf.title: Valley
oneOf.description: A broad, low east-west corridor between raised northern and southern sides.

oneOf.title: Plateau
oneOf.description: A wide central flat summit with smooth slopes down to the surrounding plain.

oneOf.title: Mountain range
oneOf.description: Three parallel ridges with alternating peaks and passes.

oneOf.title: Flat
oneOf.description: A level plain at world Y=0.

oneOf.title: Hills in four corners
oneOf.description: Four rounded hills near the corners with an open central plain.

oneOf.title: City blocks
oneOf.description: Regular streets between raised, flat-roofed heightfield blocks. Block edges slope over one sample interval; no separate building meshes or hidden object colliders.

seed.description: Generation seed for the named preset. Clients still render transmitted samples.

description: World snapshot sent by the server once on each client connection and again whenever the client requests it or an admin changes the terrain. Includes size and terrain; not repeated in the approximately 15 Hz game-state stream.
